title: Asking About a Missing Transcript Entry

prompt.scenario: You recently completed an intensive summer course in organic chemistry, but the final grade does not appear on your unofficial academic transcript. You need an updated record to apply for a hospital research internship by this Friday. Write an email to the registrar coordinator, Ms. Delaney.
requirements: Explain the missing summer course grade on your academic transcript record.

Dear Ms. Delaney,

I am writing to inquire about a missing course entry on my academic transcript record.

I successfully completed Chemistry 220 (Organic Chemistry) during the second summer session, earning a final grade of A-. However, when I checked my unofficial transcript on the student portal this morning, the course was not listed under my completed credits. Because I am submitting an application for a competitive clinical research internship this Friday, I need an official record demonstrating that I fulfilled this chemistry prerequisite. Could your office verify the instructor's grade submission and update my transcript? If the processing takes several days, would it be possible to issue a provisional letter confirming my enrollment and grade? Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan

title: Requesting an Extension for a Map Project

This two-day extension will allow us to download the server layers and render the spatial data properly. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan
